title: Evidence triage scratchpad
content:
Quick capture of things I need to sort this sprint - messy, sorry.

Context: personal scratchpad for SOC2 evidence collection, vendor checks, and policy TODOs. Not a formal tracker yet — moving items into JIRA later when stable.

Top priorities (this week):
- [ ] Finish evidence set for CC7.2 (access revocations) — list accounts removed in last 12 months + HR termination export (ask ops).
- [ ] Vendor attestation matrix refresh: add DeepVault and S3Backer entries, sanity-check cert dates.
- [ ] Prepare evidence handoff for external audit: zip of policy docs + change-log + signed AUPs.

Notes / fragments:
- CC6.1 (logical access): I have the IAM report from 2023-12 but it's missing MFA enablement timestamps for service accounts. ACTION: run 'gcloud iam service-accounts list --format=json' and correlate with sentinel tokens export. Marcus said he has the old csv.
- Evidence types acceptable: screenshots + export logs + signed spreadsheet with approver initials. Need to confirm with auditor if internal Slack confirmations are OK vs formal ticket.
- For vendor reviews, quick cheat-sheet:
    DeepVault: security questionnaire done 2023-11, SOC2 Type II pending (requested 2024-02). Current status: partial. Risk: medium. Next action: request encrypted attestation and ask for penetration test report.
    S3Backer: contract has clause on subprocessing that needs redline. Risk: low/medium. ask legal to review before renewal (renewal 2024-06).
- Quick table sketch (will move to sheet):
    Vendor | Last Attestation | Risk | Next Action | Owner
    DeepVault | 2023-11 (partial) | Medium | Request SOC2 + pentest | Jamie
    S3Backer | 2022-09 | Low/Med | Legal review clause | Asha

Random TODOs and reminders:
- Pull KMS rotation logs for all projects (how to: stackdriver logs -> filter keyRingName=redwood-prod).
- Check Vault audit-log retention: confirm >= 90 days for Private customers. If not, file infra ticket.
- Policy doc 'Third-Party Access' needs minor wording tweak: add explicit approval TTL (30d) and require JIRA ticket.

Questions to resolve (ask auditor / legal):
- Are ephemeral credentials for CI runners considered "service accounts" for CC6.1 evidence? Auditor seemed okay last year but need explicit note.
- Do we accept vendor Excel attestation with digital signature only, or need notarized copies?
- Can we use anonymized screenshots for customer-data handling evidence or do we need full exports (PII concerns)?

Meeting prep (tomorrow — 1:1 with Marcus):
- Bring list of missing artifacts for CC7.2
- Confirm who will reach out to DeepVault and set timeline (target: get attestation by 2024-05-01)
- Ask Marcus for the HR termination csv (fields: email, employee_id, termination_date, manager)

Evidence collection commands / quick snippets I keep reusing:
- Export IAM bindings: gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam_policy_YYYYMMDD.json
- List service accounts: gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=redwood-prod --format="table(email,displayName)"
- S3 object list (for evidence): aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit-exports/ --recursive --human-readable --summarize > s3_export_list.txt

Draft email snippet to vendor (copy when sending):
"Hi <vendor-contact>,
We are preparing documentation for our auditors and need your latest security attestation and penetration test summary. Please provide SOC2 Type II (if available), or other independent audit reports, plus date of last pentest and contact for security follow-up. Thanks, Jamie"

Small wins / what I did already:
- Pulled last year's external audit checklist (confluence CONFLUENCE-SEC-3421) and highlighted controls with missing artifacts.
- Confirmed that SSO logs are being retained for 12 months in hosted (need to confirm for private deployments).

Final-ish notes / things to move out of this scratchpad soon:
- Build a one-pager checklist for "evidence package for audit" (zip + manifest + approver list + contact matrix) and attach to Jira SOC2-58.
- Draft a short policy blurb for Third-Party Access and share for quick review by legal (Asha).

---
Other stray items:
- If audit requests MFA per-user enrollment dates, we might need to combine Okta export with DB user creation dates. Planning: okta export -> join on email -> create csv.
- Consider a quick internal script to snapshot config (IAM) monthly and push to s3://redwood-compliance-snapshots/ (low priority).

End of scratchpad. Will tidy up and split into tickets on Friday.
